title: Law to require “look up” markings near crosswalks
summary: This bill would require the Department of Transportation to paint pedestrian safety markings, such as “LOOK UP” or “LOOK BOTH WAYS,” at no fewer than 500 intersections citywide, including at least 50 per borough and 200 near schools. DOT would inspect and repaint these markings every five years. The bill also requires DOT to distribute street safety educational materials to public and other schools each year.
